operations.label: shared lib files
operations._note: Runs AFTER oversight + output so it overwrites the lib/{config,file-lock,framework}.js shims with self-contained canonical files. Post-install scripts have no relative ../../../shared/ dependency. fs-atomic.js is required by config.js (writeConfig), so it must ship alongside. framework.js is required by rh-fw.js (installed to scriptsDir, so ./lib/framework resolves here), rh-daily-validate.js and rh-config-integrity.js; it depends on nothing but node builtins, deliberately — rh-fw.js runs per hook invocation.
